analysis.title: Analysis & Recommendations
findings: SA-Temp-50000ms achieves the best score with -10 hard / -30k medium / 365k soft. It significantly outperforms all other configurations.
Tabu Search variants are reliable performers at -15 to -17 hard violations, with Tabu-Entity-Size5 and Tabu-Entity-Size10 leading the group.
Move evaluation speed correlates strongly with solution quality. Top solvers achieve ~14,000 evals/sec while VND struggles at ~1,900/sec.
All VND variants perform poorly (-79 to -96 hard) due to 7x slower move evaluation speed, getting stuck in local optima.
Simulated Annealing's temperature-based acceptance enables better exploration of the search space than Tabu's memory-based approach.
recommendations: Use SA-Temp-50000ms (Simulated Annealing with 50000ms temperature) as the production solver. It achieves the fewest hard violations by a wide margin.
Tabu Search with entity tabu size 5-10 is a reliable fallback if SA fails. It delivers consistent -15 to -17 hard performance across runs.
Avoid VND (Variable Neighborhood Descent) for this problem type. Its slow move evaluation speed (1,900/sec) causes poor convergence.
Monitor move evaluation speed during solver runs. Anything below 10,000/sec indicates performance problems that will affect solution quality.
